LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.Patches.Title: Patches
LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.Energopatch.Label: Energy patch
LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.Energopatch.Desc: Reduces the energy consumption of life support systems by 2x, and the small life support system by 3x.\n\nApplied in-game, but a restart may be required.
LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.Odysseytexpatch.Label: Odyssey hull graphics
LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.Odysseytexpatch.Desc: Replaces the graphics of the Save Our Ship mod with textures from the Odyssey add-on.\n\nApplied in-game, but a restart is required.
LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.ThrustersPatch.Label: Odyssey thrusters graphics
LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.ThrustersPatch.Desc: Replaces the graphics of the Save Our Ship mod with textures from the Odyssey add-on. Also changes the rendering layer of the RCS thruster from SOS so it doesn't appear over other structures.\n\nApplied in-game, but a restart is required.
LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.HoverModepatch.Label: Russian translation patch
LanguageData.ARL.SOSSets.HoverModepatch.Desc: Replaces the text "Hover Mode" with "Режим парения" in the shuttles UI. Use this if you want to learn some russian words.\n\nApplied in-game, but a restart may be required.
